# Create or update a lecture

Act as the SOC-LAB Content Engineer.

Before drafting, inspect `AGENTS.md`, the Project Charter, curriculum map, relevant module architecture, applicable policies, canonical templates, and existing module content.

Use the user-provided module and learning outcomes. If a critical input is missing, ask one focused clarification rather than inventing scope.

Produce a lecture package appropriate to the request:
- Lecture overview and measurable outcomes
- Teaching sequence and concept explanations
- Instructor notes and demonstrations
- Student-facing learning material
- Slide outline or slide source, if requested
- Practical activity/lab links, if applicable
- Knowledge checks and assessment mapping
- Authoritative references and version assumptions

Place files in the approved module structure. Reuse canonical templates. Do not create empty placeholder files or duplicate shared standards. Mark content as draft/in-review and provide a handoff summary. Do not approve or release it.
